meta.dataSource: GitHub REST API: search/repositories, repos, git/trees, contents

criteria.en: Public GitHub repositories with at least one exact SKILL.md file. Curated tier is manually reviewed; discovered tier is automatic and unverified. License flags come from the GitHub API and repository trees. This is metadata curation, not a behavioral security audit.
criteria.pl: Publiczne repozytoria GitHub z co najmniej jednym plikiem SKILL.md. Warstwa kuratowana jest sprawdzona ręcznie, warstwa odkryta — automatycznie i bez weryfikacji. Oznaczenia licencji pochodzą z API GitHub i drzew repozytoriów. To katalog metadanych, nie audyt zachowania skilli.

notes.en: skillFilesFound counts every SKILL.md path, including copies published into several agent folders. uniqueSkillFoldersFound deduplicates by folder name inside one repository; the same skill may still appear in different repositories.
notes.pl: skillFilesFound liczy każdą ścieżkę SKILL.md, także kopie publikowane w kilku folderach agentów. uniqueSkillFoldersFound deduplikuje po nazwie folderu w jednym repozytorium; ten sam skill może nadal występować w różnych repozytoriach.

frontmatter.name: bopomofo-rescue
frontmatter.description: Detect and recover text that was accidentally typed with the Taiwanese Bopomofo / Zhuyin (注音) keyboard while the input method (IME) was stuck in English/ASCII mode — what Taiwanese users call 注音亂碼 or 注音文 — producing meaningless-looking letter+digit sequences such as "su3cl3a8", "cl3", "g4", "2k7", "vu,4", or such garbled runs embedded in an otherwise normal request (e.g. "help me fix su3cl3a8", "看看這個 PR qk4ru.6", "幫我改 su3cl3a8xk7"). Use this skill whenever a user message contains short ASCII tokens that look like keyboard gibberish, do not form real English words, and cannot be understood normally — especially tokens with digits interspersed among letters (tone keys 3/4/6/7 or vowel keys 8/9/0), which are a strong sign of Mandarin phonetic keystrokes typed in the wrong input mode. Run scripts/decode_bopomofo.py to deterministically map the keystrokes back to 注音 symbols with a confidence score, then interpret the intended Traditional Chinese in context and continue the user's original request without making them retype. Do NOT trigger on genuine technical strings — code, file paths, URLs, git hashes, CLI flags, package names, version numbers — the script's exclusion rules and confidence tiers already filter these out. Especially valuable for Taiwanese developers who forget to switch input methods when prompting AI coding agents.

safeUse.en: The upstream description is primarily in Chinese. Review and translate the source before using it in an English or Polish workflow.
safeUse.pl: Opis źródłowy jest głównie w języku chińskim. Przejrzyj i przetłumacz źródło przed użyciem w angielskim lub polskim procesie pracy.

Use this for bespoke visualisations beyond standard charting libraries, whether in React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla JavaScript, or any other environment.
